name: Retired modern .NET target framework
description: Flags projects that target .NET 5, .NET 6, or .NET 7 monikers that are retired for current modernization planning.
impact: Retired modern .NET targets can hide runtime, hosting, and dependency risk even when the application is no longer on .NET Framework.
evidenceRequirements: Project target framework metadata must be available from extracted project facts.
recommendedActions: Move to the repository's supported .NET target after dependency and hosting compatibility checks are complete.
